$comment: The upstream unit costs Citadel pays, one entry per figure: the SSOT billing/derive.mjs prices from (x billing/pricing-model.json -> the DERIVED prices in billing/tiers.json). Written only by scripts/rates/update-rates.mjs (weekly, .github/workflows/rates.yml), never by hand. `raw` is the exact text the parser matched on `source`; an entry's `fetched_at` is when its value last changed, and the top-level one is the last run that changed any.
